_comment: Oracle scan configuration. Edit this file. Run: oracle-hunter prescan --sync

scan._comment_platforms: all scans every registered source. Set a list or comma-separated string to narrow, e.g. ["hackerone", "bugcrowd"].

filter._comment_payout: Require at least $500 payout. 0 = no upper limit.
filter._comment_reports: <=100 resolved reports = less picked over. Programs with no report count are kept.
filter._comment_fast: fast_triage_only OFF — fast triage is a bonus, not a hard requirement. Triage ranker scores it.
filter._comment_new: new_programs_only = launched within new_program_days days. new_assets scored by triage ranker (new_assets weight 0.30 in triage.yaml).
filter._comment_kind: web2 + web3 both on. Set one to false to narrow.
filter._comment_pick: pick_per_platform = top N shown, downloaded, and hunted per platform. Set null to use global top_n instead.

queue._comment_order: finish-site exhausts every company on one site, then moves on; round-robin takes the first company per site in rotation.
queue._comment_parallel: concurrent = cross-site parallelism on/off. Sequential within a site, always (one rate-limit bucket).
queue._comment_cap: cross_site_cap = max parallel sites when concurrent.
queue._comment_count: default_count = programs to deep-dive when scan -N is not given (explicit --sites still overrides the count).

researcher.note: Researcher handle used in compliance request headers

quality_gates._comment: INITIAL bars (docs/GATE_SPEC.md). Recalibrate after first full gate run. Gate is confidence-only, non-blocking for money.
quality_gates._comment_recall: P2-lock (doctrine #5): 1.0 = zero misses in covered classes. Machine-enforced by tests/test_p2_recall_bar.py; do not lower without a doctrine change.

platform_auth._comment: Policy only. Put real values in .env or an authenticated browser session, never in this file.
